UEFA, Concacaf, and the Asian Football Confederation are now jointly developing an alternative governance framework for world football, going beyond boycott threats to propose a replacement system. Calls for Infantino's resignation have reached a fever pitch. Trump has intervened publicly on Truth Social to defend Infantino, calling his potential ouster a 'terrible mistake' and praising his stewardship of the World Cup. During the World Cup, US federal authorities seized 44 drones and $9 million in fake FIFA merchandise in Houston.
